content: Death smiles upon every mortal; all that a noble human can do is smile back with dignity.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
explanation: Death is the universal democrat: it makes no exceptions for kings, geniuses, billionaires, or saints. To live in trembling, frantic terror of mortality is to die a thousand times before the body falls. Acknowledge your inevitable departure, smile at the mystery, and live today with heroic presence.
practicalInsight: Remember your mortality (Memento Mori) today. Let it dissolve petty anxieties and fill your hours with sacred clarity.
reflectionPrompt: If today were your final day on this earth, would you spend it arguing over the trifles currently bothering you?
